title: Where Is Momo?
author: Tadoku Note (original)
summary: 朝、猫のモモがいない！ ケンは家じゅうを探します。

source.note: Original text written for this app.

paragraphs: Momo is a small white cat. She lives with Ken and his mother.
One morning, Ken cannot find Momo. She is not on the sofa. She is not under the table. She is not in the kitchen.
“Mom, where is Momo?” Ken asks. “I don’t know,” his mother says. “Look in your room.”
Ken looks in his room. He looks under the bed. He looks in the closet. No Momo.
Ken goes outside. He looks in the garden. He looks in the tree. “Momo! Momo!” he calls. No cat.
Ken is sad. He sits down on the steps. Maybe Momo is lost. Maybe she is cold and hungry.
Then he hears a sound. “Meow.” It is very small. Where is it?
“Meow.” Ken stands up. The sound is near the car. He looks in the car. No. He looks under the car. No.
He opens the big box next to the car. It is a box for old clothes. And there is Momo! She is sleeping on an old blue sweater.
Momo opens her eyes. She looks at Ken. “Meow,” she says. She is not lost. She is warm and happy.
Ken laughs. He picks her up. “You are a bad cat,” he says. But he is smiling.
Now the old blue sweater is Momo’s bed. She sleeps on it every day.
